title: Scan address
hint: Point at a wallet QR code

reject.unsupported: Not a supported wallet address. Scan a testnet address QR.
reject.checksum: This address failed its checksum. Ask the recipient for a new code.
reject.unsupportedNetwork: This code is for a network the wallet doesn't support. Only Sepolia and Amoy testnets work.
reject.missingNetwork: This payment request doesn't say which network it's for.
reject.tokenRequest: Token payment requests aren't supported yet. Scan a plain address instead.
reject.assetMismatch: This code is for a different network or asset than the one you're sending.

camera.permissionBody: Allow camera access to scan a recipient's QR code. Frames are processed on-device and never stored.
camera.deniedBody: Camera access for Nadir Wallet is turned off. Turn it on in Settings to scan a QR code, or close this and enter the address instead.
camera.noDeviceBody: This device has no back camera. Close this and enter the address instead.
camera.unavailableBody: The scanner couldn't start on this device. Close this and enter the address instead.
